body:
> makes sense, thanks! maybe we can refactor this at a later point to have one function that deals with item template rendering as it's the same between hits and recommend. Good separate for now too though

Yeah, initially I tried to get it to use the same item template, but I think the types are a bit weird in that the item templates differ between the hits widgets and recommend widgets. Not sure if that's intentional, but since there might be the use case that we want separate item templates anyway, I didn't want to spend too much time debugging the type errors.
